colocated-lite-query-timeouts.observation: Repeated four-validator PQ functional runs on one host (four validator processes plus one DHT process) contain unanswered lite-server queries. ExtClient.cpp:69 gives each query a 10.0-second deadline. Three consecutive runs each exposed an observation interval within about one percent of ten seconds. One run recorded node-1 get_masterchain_info=1. A later run recorded total=3 on node-2: get_masterchain_info=2 and lookup_block=1, with one retry inside the interval window. The retry permits a green functional result, so the counters are the only durable indication of the degraded run.

observed_at.cluster_shape: four co-located PQ validators plus one DHT process

colocated-lite-query-timeouts.diagnostic_question: For each timed-out query, did the request reach the selected lite-server? Receipt without a client response localizes the loss to server processing or the response path; no receipt localizes it to ingress or request transport.
colocated-lite-query-timeouts.closure_condition: Capture the same query identity at the client send point, lite-server receipt point, response send point and client completion point in a reproducing run; identify the first missing transition and add a regression gate for the demonstrated cause. Changing the timeout or relying on retry success is not closure.
